description: An HTML file demonstrating event propagation and dynamic creation of Canvas widgets with click event handlers using the Isomorphic SmartClient library.

methods.name: Page.setEvent
methods.description: Sets a global event handler for page events, here used for click events with confirmation dialog.

methods.name: Canvas.create
methods.description: Creates Canvas widgets with specified properties, used here to build nested UI components.

methods.name: addChild
methods.description: Adds a child widget to a parent Canvas widget.
